text:
Sam: Quick one  Our EMEA eng pod has a national holiday that falls during the Sep product blackout (Sep 20). Do those hours count against the new 48h carryover cap? Need to tell folks before next week.
Anika: Are you talking about the updated policy that kicks in Jul 1? We have people who accrued >48h from last year.
people-ops: Yes, the Jul 1 cutover sets the maximum carryover to 48h. Relevant points: 1) We use the balance on the carryover cutoff (Aug 31 23:59 UTC) to determine what carries. 2) Regional public holidays that occur during a blackout still count as PTO if an employee submits PTO for them; they therefore reduce carried balance unless an exception is approved.
Sam: hmm, so someone who planned their national holiday and had 60h would drop to 48h automatically? That could be rough.
people-ops: Correct, standard flow reduces to 48h. We intentionally kept an exceptions process for fairness. Submit the "Carryover Exception" form and attach the manager approval if the PTO is tied to a statutory holiday or relocation/visa requirement. Exception reviewers will prioritize statutory obligations and regional public holidays.
Jon: What about new hires who started Jul 15? Do they get prorated accrual and a carryover calculation? Payroll in EMEA sometimes rounds down.
people-ops: New hires get prorated accruals for their first month. Carryover uses the actual balance recorded in the HRIS at cutoff. If payroll rounding causes a 0.5h discrepancy, we round to the nearest 0.25h for display and make manual adjustments on approved exceptions.
Anika: Can you paste the manager-signoff template I can forward to leads?
people-ops: Manager sign-off template (pasteable):

---
Manager approval: I approve a carryover exception for [EMPLOYEE NAME] (employee id: [ID]).
Reason: [statutory holiday / travel / coverage conflict / other]
Requested carryover hours: [X hours]
Dates impacted: [date range]
Manager: [Name] | Email: [email]
---

people-ops: Process summary: 1) Employee submits exception form (link in handbook). 2) Manager attaches approval. 3) People Ops reviews vs coverage needs and statutory obligations. 4) Final decision communicated within 5 business days.
hr-bot: Policy update posted: https://intranet.redwood/policies/pto (automated).
Sam: great, I'll ping the pod and collect approvals this week. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Jon: one more Q  if someone is on unpaid leave during Aug cutoff, do they forfeit carryover?
people-ops: Unpaid leave pauses accruals. Carryover eligibility uses the balance at cutoff; if unpaid leave reduced the balance below the cap we cannot retroactively restore accruals, but exceptions can be requested for hardship cases.
Anika: copied into our sync notes. Will follow up if any edge cases come up.
Sam: tagging @people-ops when I have the forms.
